title: Microsoft Windows: attackers can run commands on it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 25 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Computers, phones and browsers
category.why: It runs on staff computers, phones or browsers.
category.doThis: Install the latest updates on every device, and turn on automatic updates.

summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 16, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
